title: Member messages: a full conversation, the not-online page and the error with Try again are never seen on screen
what: The screen test of Member messages covers the not-switched-on page and a message that is gone. No test opens a conversation that has reached its limit, so nobody checks that the reply box goes away and Mark as done stays. No test opens the page for a gym that is not online, or makes the list fail to load to see the red line and Try again, for the owner or the front desk. Only the words and the server refusal are checked.
expected: Screen tests open a full conversation, a gym not online and a failed load, for the owner and the desk, and check the words, the missing reply box and that Try again reloads the list.
fix_line: Add the full, not-online and failed-load cases to the Member messages screen test
